name: Oster-Ei-Boot
description: Geköpftes Ei mit Mini-Holzboot auf Eigelb, Dose-Reveal

consistency.reference_prompt: Warm morning light, German breakfast table, white tablecloth, Easter decoration in pastel colors, spring flowers, soft shadows, photorealistic, high quality
consistency.lighting: warm morning side-lighting from left window
consistency.negative_global: ugly, distorted, text, watermark, logo, product cans, bottles, brand names, plastic, AI artifacts, cartoon, illustration

clips.description: Close-up geköpftes Ei im Eierbecher, Kamera zoomt langsam rein
clips.image_prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 close-up of a soft-boiled egg in an elegant ceramic egg cup, cleanly cracked open revealing orange yolk. White tablecloth, Easter decoration (pastel eggs, spring flowers) softly blurred in background. Warm morning light from left window. Shallow depth of field.
clips.video_prompt: Slow smooth camera zoom into the egg, slight steam rising, warm morning light shifts gently. Shallow depth of field. 6 seconds.

clips.image_prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 close-up of SAME egg cup and egg, but now a tiny handcrafted wooden sailboat (~3cm) floats on the orange yolk. Boat has warm oiled wood finish, mini fabric sail. Yolk looks like golden sea. SAME tablecloth, SAME lighting, SAME Easter decoration blurred in background.
clips.video_prompt: Tiny wooden boat gently bobbing on egg yolk, slight rotation, warm light reflects on oiled wood surface. Camera holds steady with subtle breathing motion. 6 seconds.

clips.image_prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 extreme macro of tiny wooden sailboat on egg yolk. Beautiful wood grain visible, oiled surface catches light. Yolk surrounds boat like golden water. Very shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh. Warm light.
clips.video_prompt: Extreme close-up of wooden boat on yolk, camera slowly pulls back to reveal more of the egg. Light plays on oiled wood surface. Dreamy shallow depth of field. 4 seconds.

clips.image_prompt: Photorealistic 9:16 wide shot of SAME Easter breakfast table. The egg cup with boat visible in center. Around it: more eggs, toast, jam, Easter bunny figurines, spring flowers in vase, coffee cups. Morning light streams through window. Warm, inviting, slightly surreal. SAME tablecloth, SAME decoration style.
clips.video_prompt: Camera slowly pulls back from egg to reveal full Easter breakfast table, morning light shifts gently, slight movement in flower arrangement from breeze. 8 seconds.

music.style: gentle acoustic guitar, morning mood, Easter spring feeling
